title: English Vocabulary Quiz B1: 20 Questions - Can You Find the Better Word?
description:
English vocabulary quiz B1: 20 questions with answers. In each question you find the better word for a plain one.
This English vocabulary quiz (B1 level, intermediate) starts from words you already say - very happy, very tired, nice, help, give, but - and asks you to pick the better word from three choices. You have five seconds for each answer, then you see the right word in the sentence and one more example.

Count your points and write your score in the comments.

Chapters
0:00 Questions 1-5: feelings
2:04 Questions 6-10: describing
4:06 Questions 11-15: verbs
6:04 Questions 16-20: the hardest five
8:04 Your score
8:18 Your turn

Your score
17-20: excellent
12-16: good
0-11: try again

Find another word for any word on anotherwordfor.net
